According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is preparing major changes to its retail stores in anticipation of the upcoming Home product line launch. Apple will release at least an updated HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K this autumn, and the related changes also suggest a third, more important product will debut at the same time.

Apple's Home product line has been backlogged for a long time, mainly due to repeated delays in the Siri overhaul project. Now that Siri has finally completed its integration, these products that have been stalled for years are expected to finally be officially released.

However, earlier reports indicated that Apple would first release updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (also known as a HomePod or HomePad with a display) may not be released until later.

However, based on the retail store deployment, it now appears that this smart home hub may launch simultaneously with the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. Content from the Power On newsletter:

Of course, we'll have to wait until Apple's September event to confirm. However, based on today's report, it seems we'll soon get a glimpse of Apple's all-new smart home hub, which will debut alongside the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, all of which also support the new Siri AI.

Summary

As a recap, the Apple smart home hub is rumored to feature a 7-inch square display and will come in two versions: one with built-in speakers, and another with magnets on the back for wall-mounting installation. The product will run a brand-new operating system with a home screen that supports widgets. In addition to serving as a FaceTime calling device, it will of course also act as the hub for all smart home accessories and Siri. On the hardware side, it will be powered by an A18 chip.

Another new rumor about the Home product line is that the new Apple TV 4K may come with a redesigned Siri Remote, though the specific changes remain unknown for now.

Are you interested in the new Home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments section.
